title: 1625 Prairie's oriel stands on a darker stone base
items: In 1904, the panel under the small bay window on 1625 Prairie's south wall is now the house front's rough brownstone rather than the bay's pale smooth stone. In the 1890 photograph it reads darker and rougher than the wall beside it, in the same sunlight, so it is the stone and not a shadow.
With that, the house matches its photograph in everything the photograph shows.
